newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND STRIKE BACK AFTER COLLAPSE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND STRIKE BACK AFTER COLLAPSE.

text.p: Darren Gough and Dean Headley took two wickets each as England fought back in the fourth test on Friday after Australian paceman Jason Gillespie wrecked their first innings with a seven-wicket haul.

After the home side had been dismissed for 172 in their first innings, the England pace duo reduced Australia to 50 for four before Matthew Elliott and Ricky Ponting put together an unbeaten stand of 64,leaving Australia on 114 for four at tea, 58 behind.
Gillespie, bowling with great pace down the Headingley slope and finding some swing, took six for 23 in the morning session to finish with seven for 37, easily his best figures in test
